The question asks about the adversary of Pixie and Dixie who famously said "I hate those meeces to pieces." This is from the cartoon segment that appeared on The Huckleberry Hound Show.

The character in question is a cat who constantly chased the two mice (Pixie and Dixie). His full name was "Mr. Jinks" (sometimes referred to as just "Jinks"). The catchphrase "I hate those meeces to pieces" (with the deliberate mispronunciation of "mice" as "meeces") was his signature line.

All four agents have identified essentially the same answer - either "Mr. Jinks" or "Jinks the Cat" - which are both correct references to the same character. The official name is "Mr. Jinks."
